meta.title: YADAYADAS — A David Bowie Live Experience
meta.description: YADAYADAS is a six-piece Israeli live band performing a David Bowie tribute show that isn't a costume act — it's a discovery. The music is the vehicle. The man is the mystery.

eras.name: BERLIN
eras.line: THE THIN WHITE DUKE HAD TO DISAPPEAR.

band.heading: SIX MUSICIANS.
band.intro:
YADAYADAS is a meeting of six musicians from very different backgrounds — world music, progressive rock, pop-punk, live performance, production, high-tech, and a lot of hours on stage.

And that might be exactly what makes the show interesting: not an attempt to imitate David Bowie, but six musicians bringing themselves into his music.

quotes.primary: Who am I now? What happens if I become this person? When do I need to leave him behind? And who do I become next?

final.line1: DAVID BOWIE WAS NEVER JUST ONE PERSON.
